target.title: fix(cli): tab-complete command aliases
target.body:
Closes #99406

## What Problem This Solves

Fixes an issue where users installing OpenClaw shell completion could not tab-complete documented command aliases such as `capability`, `chat`, `terminal`, or nested aliases like `cron create`.

## Why This Change Was Made

The completion generators now derive command names from Commander canonical names plus aliases and use alias-expanded command paths for nested dispatch. The change is limited to shell completion output generation and regression coverage.

## User Impact

Users can tab-complete both canonical commands and their documented aliases in zsh, Bash, fish, and PowerShell, including nested alias paths and options under those paths.

## Evidence

- `node scripts/run-vitest.mjs src/cli/completion-cli.test.ts` passed.
- `COREPACK_HOME=/tmp/openclaw-corepack pnpm exec oxfmt --check --threads=1 src/cli/completion-cli.ts src/cli/completion-cli.test.ts` passed.
- `COREPACK_HOME=/tmp/openclaw-corepack pnpm exec oxlint src/cli/completion-cli.ts src/cli/completion-cli.test.ts` passed.
- `git diff --check` passed.
